references.text: Speaks about being hated for the Lord's name's sake, which mirrors what Jesus says about being hated for his name's sake
Jesus warns again of persecution and the necessity of enduring to the end to be saved, paralleling the message in Matthew 10:22
Mark repeats the message about being hated for Jesus' name's sake and the necessity of endurance
Luke also highlights that disciples will be hated for Jesus' name's sake and the need for perseverance
Acts shows that faith through trials and persecutions is part of the Christian faith
Peter speaks of the joy of suffering for Christ, which resonates with the idea of being hated for his name's sake
